title: Primordial Paradox enemies file
description: Every enemy the battle director can start. Numbers here are the whole of the balance: no enemy stat lives in GML. Ranges mirror the constants in tools/check_data.py and tests/test_schemas.py compares the two.

attack.description: Damage range of a plain hit, inclusive. min above max is refused by the checker.

reward.description: What the fight gives. kind item and power name an id in those tables; health gives a flat amount and names nothing.

sprite.description: Sprite resource name. Placeholder until the 8 bit look pass.

element.description: Free form damage element tag, sea, fire, veil and so on.

route_kind.description: Boss fights count toward the route ledger differently. Defaults to regular when absent.

patterns.description: The bullet patterns this enemy may use, by id in data/patterns/all.json.

talk_dialogue.description: Dialogue id played by the TALK command.

trust_to_spare.description: TALK count that reaches the spare threshold.

spare_hp_percent.description: HP percentage at or below which SPARE is allowed.
